about:
An Information Systems professional with 3+ years of experience in software development, with a focus on Android applications. 

 My background in development has taught me to look at technology not only from the implementation side, but also from the perspective of problems, users, requirements, and solutions. I enjoy breaking down problems, understanding how systems and processes work, identifying issues, and turning them into practical solutions. I also enjoy collaborating with different teams to discuss requirements, evaluate ideas, and find solutions that are both useful and technically feasible. 

I am interested in exploring opportunities across Software Development and System Analysis, where I can combine my technical foundation with my analytical and problem-solving skills to build and improve systems that create real value.
